usage: The word '買餸' (maai5 sung3) is commonly used as a noun meaning 'buy ingredients' or 'buy groceries'.
It refers specifically to the act or the items involved when purchasing food ingredients for cooking.
You can use '買餸' when talking about daily tasks related to shopping for meals.
It usually appears in conversations about meals, cooking plans, or household chores.
You can say '去街市買餸' to mean 'go to the market to buy ingredients.'
